Other values are visible draft engineering choices needing pilot calibration. strain_targets are the target strain samples the curve is sampled at (RB-011): configure them to match the experiment (this example keeps the paper's 11 points up to 0.300, so a 20% compression curve fails TARGET_RANGE_NOT_REACHED by design).
